repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-support
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.support for support and log-upload endpoints. getFeedbackUrl() POSTs users/deskFeedbackUrl and getSupportUrl() GETs users/deskSupportUrl on the conversation service, each resolving body.url. submitLogs() takes the SDK logger's full or incremental (diff) log text, or caller-supplied logs, and uploads it through webex.upload to the clientLogs service in three phases (logs/urls, PUT to the returned tempURL, logs/meta with a key-value metadata array), authorizing with the user token or, failing that, a client token; it advances the logger's last-submitted index on success and, for a failed diff upload with retryFailedLogUploadsAtNextInterval, rolls the logger back so the next diff resends the span. It stores nothing itself.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-support package entry
public_interfaces.audience: first-party Webex clients and the SDK packages that register it
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports the device plugin, then registers Support as internal plugin 'support' with config.support defaults {appType: '', appVersion: '', languageCode: '', incrementalLogs: false} and config.device.preDiscoveryServices entries for atlas and clientLogs; the first registration of the name wins. The default export is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.support methods
public_interfaces.notes: submitLogs uploads the logger's full or diff log text (or the given logs) to the clientLogs service through webex.upload with a key-value metadata list, commits the logger index on success, rolls it back for a failed diff upload when config.support.retryFailedLogUploadsAtNextInterval is truthy, and always rejects with the upload error. getFeedbackUrl and getSupportUrl resolve body.url from the conversation service; getFeedbackUrl modifies the caller's options object.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not retry the upload inside submitLogs.
negative_guidance.why: webex.upload retries its upload phase, and the diff rollback defers failed spans to the next call.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not commit or roll back the logger index outside the upload result handlers.
negative_guidance.why: The index decides which logs the next diff upload sends.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not swallow an upload rejection.
negative_guidance.why: Callers in calling, contact-center, and plugin-meetings log and report the failure.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log log text, metadata values, tokens, user ids, or org ids.
negative_guidance.why: They are user and identity data; the only existing log line carries an error object.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as a usage reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its Usage block names a placeholder member; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage script or threshold exists.
